newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack jumps after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack jumps after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in Railtrack Plc gained on Friday after the company reported better-than-expected half year pre-tax profits, traders said.
The shares jumped 16-1/2p to 301-1/2p by 0817 GMT.
Railtrack said pre-tax profits rose to 173 million stg from or the half year to September 30. Analysts' forecasts were in a range of 149 to 155 million stg.

"The tax charge and profits from property were higher than expected but the fundamentals look fine. Let's see what the company says at the meeting," said one analyst. --Andrew Langlands, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
